label: WardStock - Oura Backfill
info:
Manual, on-demand flow (not scheduled) to backfill full-fidelity historical Oura data straight into InfluxDB, bypassing GoDaddy's curated summary entirely -- a manual pull through GoDaddy only captures sleep_duration_hrs/sleep_efficiency/resting_hr/hrv/steps (a small curated subset). This flow archives everything oura_sync_flow.json's InfluxDB half already logs for live data -- every scalar field per record, plus decomposed 5-minute heart_rate/hrv time series -- for a whole historical range instead of just 'today'.

HOW TO USE: open the 'Manual trigger' inject node, edit its JSON payload to the range you want -- {"start_date":"YYYY-MM-DD","end_date":"YYYY-MM-DD"} -- then click it (the button on the node, or Deploy then click). Re-edit and re-click for a different range; nothing about this flow remembers a previous range.

ANSWERING THE 'does it know where the data is' QUESTION: no discovery step exists or is needed -- you just pick a range as wide as you want (even back before you started wearing the ring), and Oura's API simply returns whatever real records actually exist inside it; periods with nothing recorded just come back empty, not as an error. An overly wide range costs a few empty pages, nothing worse.

PAGINATION: unlike the live sync flow's narrow 3-day window (which only ever needed one page), a real historical range can span many pages of Oura's cursor-based next_token pagination. This flow loops each of the three endpoints (sleep, daily_activity, daily_readiness) in turn until next_token stops appearing, with a 500-page safety cap per endpoint (warns and stops cleanly with whatever was collected so far if that cap is ever actually hit, rather than looping forever).

WRITES TO INFLUXDB IN CHUNKS (500 lines per POST, brief pause between chunks) rather than one giant request -- a multi-year backfill with decomposed heart_rate/hrv series can produce tens of thousands of lines, and one request that size risks hitting a body-size limit somewhere in the chain for no real benefit over a few hundred smaller ones. The debug panel shows a running 'writing chunk N/M' message per chunk plus a final summary line, so a long backfill still gives visible progress.

Does NOT push anything to GoDaddy or touch HA helper entities -- this is purely a raw-data archival tool for InfluxDB. Does still log a start/finish point to InfluxDB's sync_job_runs measurement (job_name=oura_backfill), same convention as the other flows, so a run is visible/confirmable there too.

UNTESTED, same caveat as every other flow in this project -- built from oura_sync_flow.json's proven-live logic (as of Aug 2026, after its Aug 2026 fixes: the missing InfluxDB start-point prep node, the NaN-unsafe token-expiry check, and the api-call-service schema change) but never run end-to-end itself yet. No separate companion test flow for this one specifically -- it's already a manual, on-demand diagnostic tool in its own right, same reasoning as why system_test_flow.json doesn't have one either (PLAN.md §2).

Load secrets + start job log

Merge fetched values into msg.secrets

Check token expiry
Save refreshed token to secrets file
Write refreshed tokens to secrets file
Log failure
Prepare finish-point write (failed)
Init /sleep pagination
Accumulate page, loop or continue
Init /daily_activity pagination
Accumulate page, loop or continue
Init /daily_readiness pagination
Accumulate page, loop or continue
Build InfluxDB lines (full fidelity, no GoDaddy summary)
Split lines into write-sized chunks
Next chunk, or done?
Prepare chunk write
Log success + summarize
Prepare finish-point write
